caption: The drawing features a rectangular section filled with an elaborate decorative pattern. The background is a deep reddish color. The design is composed of large, curling scrolls and leaves in shades of beige and light yellow, outlined and filled with blue dots. Interspersed among the scrolls are groups of flowers with pink and red petals and yellow centers, as well as blue and green leaves and accents. The scrolls and flowers are arranged in a repeating, symmetrical pattern, filling the entire rectangular area. The outer border of the drawing is a plain off-white color, framing the intricate central pattern. There are no other objects or figures present in the drawing.
title: Chintz
